title: Trojan War, the Bronze Age collapse and the Greek Dark Age

tellings.quote: You have the height of the Bronze Age, then you have the Troj, you know, you have the Trojan War, and then the Trojans war seems to coincide with the fall of the Bronze Age.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, offers a view of ancient Greek history. He says that after the peak of the Bronze Age, the era when people made tools and weapons of bronze, came the Trojan War, the legendary war over the city of Troy, and that this war seems to line up in time with the collapse of the Bronze Age world. If so, the old war story would be tied to the fall of a whole civilisation.
